requirement: Owner M6 review: one question per issue; revision retracts previous answer; status follows acts, not read order.

bug.scope: Revised generic human replies in unpromoted M6
bug.reproduction: A only (resolved), then Reopen for B (unresolved): two questions and two live answers before fix.
bug.containment: Main remained accepted M5 while fixing; no historical case migration or modification.
bug.disposition: Fixed at this code commit; conditional owner M6 acceptance can close.

behavior.question_operation: m6-question:{issue_id}, recorded once at first reply
behavior.revision: Save immutable answer content; retract prior decision as authenticated owner; answer same reopened question; project separately.
behavior.reader: Only unique active eligible answer; no answer clears stale decision/resolved projection fields.
behavior.recovery: Bound native operation IDs and existing exact receipt recovery retain original retraction target; exact repeat adds no acts.
behavior.historical_cases: Read-only legacy fallback only when no native question exists.

regression.scope: Focused surrounding regression on current fix; not a new whole-repository run

reused_full_suite.limitation: Predates this three-file review fix; current changes verified by focused regression above.

checks: reopened question can be answered under existing S2

remaining: Engineering review of pilot criteria and HP02 page 115 remains pending.
